testData: Project "Preview demo" is seeded at startup with tickets whose titles start with [seed]: three merged tickets with completed agent executions (Claude and Codex, spread over three weeks), a relaunched ticket in the done column with an open PR (a failed first execution, then a successful one), a legacy merged ticket without executions or a precise implementation start, a failed ticket and a TODO ticket. The statistics page therefore shows durations, costs and weekly deliveries. Agents are simulated (KANBAN_DRY_RUN=1): no real session, pull request or merge happens, and launching a ticket only runs a simulated flow. The application has no login.
